svg.text: Request arrives with identity in headers (JWT user id, X-Forwarded-For IP, X-API-Key)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gateway sends one atomic Lua script: refill by elapsed time, test, decrement, set EXPIRE

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Allowed requests are forwarded; rejected ones get HTTP 429 + X-RateLimit-Limit / -Remaining / -Reset and Retry-After

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each shard has one or more replicas; replication lag is small

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: If a shard is unreachable the gateway needs a policy: fail-open (availability, risk of cascade) or fail-closed

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Alert on Redis CPU/memory/connectivity and on entering fail-open mode

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rules are changed without deploys; push is faster for emergencies, polling is simpler

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Scale: 1M requests/s, 100M DAU, < 10 ms overhead per check; eventual consistency across nodes is acceptable

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Algorithms: fixed window (boundary bursts), sliding window log (exact but memory-heavy), sliding window counter (cheap approximation), token bucket (bursts + steady rate): chosen

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Hot keys: client-side limiting, blocklists for abusers, DDoS protection upstream; connection pooling and regional deployments for latency
